units: Targ. Lev. IX, 9; a. fr.—Part. pass. טְבִיל, f. טְבִילָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 3:15">Targ. Josh. III, 15</cite> (<he>טְבִילָן</he>?).—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:15">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>במאי טביל</he> wherewith did he purify himself (after contact with a corpse)?; <he>בנורא טביל</he> he did it by means of fire, v. <cite ref="I00053"><he>טְבִילָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 30a:20">Nidd. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לִיטְבְּלָהּ</he> let her bathe; a. fr.—

senses.gloss: to immerse, order immersion. Nidd. l. c. אַטְבְּלִינָן לה we make her bathe.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 19a:4">Bets. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>לאַטְבּוּלֵיה</he> to immerse it; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pesachim 114b:1">Pes. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>למיהדר לאַטְבּוּלֵי</he> must take the bitter herb a second time; a. e.
